title: Exchange server is not in maintenance state
description: Exchange component state, mailbox database activation policy, and applicable DAG cluster-node state MUST provide complete evidence that the server is not in maintenance. Detected maintenance indicators are reported as Unknown because maintenance may be intentional.
subject: Server

references.name: Determine the requestor that changed Server component state

remediation.description: Review the reported component state and local or remote requester, database activation policy, and cluster-node state with the Exchange administrator. Confirm whether maintenance is intentional before taking action.
remediation.scriptTemplate:
# Read-only diagnostics
Get-ServerComponentState -Identity $env:COMPUTERNAME | Select-Object Component, State, LocalStates, RemoteStates
Get-MailboxServer -Identity $env:COMPUTERNAME | Select-Object DatabaseCopyActivationDisabledAndMoveNow, DatabaseCopyAutoActivationPolicy
Get-ClusterNode -Name $env:COMPUTERNAME

considerations: An inactive component, restricted database activation policy, or non-Up DAG node is reported as Unknown, not Pass or Fail, because it may represent planned maintenance. Missing, failed, empty, or incomplete required collection is also Unknown. Cluster-node state is required only for DAG members; mailbox activation policy is not applicable to Edge servers.
